description: This file defines structures, macros, and function prototypes for the Intel SmartPHY DSL PCIe Endpoint/ACA Linux driver, including private data structures for endpoint information and PCIe adapter, as well as configuration macros and enums.

methods.name: to_aca
methods.description: Converts a dc_ep_priv pointer to a dc_aca pointer.

methods.name: dc_aca_shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the ACA component for the given endpoint.

methods.name: dc_aca_info_init
methods.description: Initializes ACA information for the endpoint.

methods.name: dc_aca_start
methods.description: Starts the ACA component with specified function and start flag.

methods.name: dc_aca_stop
methods.description: Stops the ACA component, optionally resetting.

methods.name: dc_aca_init
methods.description: Initializes the ACA with provided parameters.

methods.name: dc_aca_event_addr_get
methods.description: Retrieves the event register address for ACA.

methods.name: aca_umt_msg_addr
methods.description: Gets the UMT message address for ACA.

methods.name: dc_aca_txin_hd_cnt
methods.description: Returns the count of HD transactions in ACA.

methods.name: dc_aca_free_fw_file
methods.description: Frees the firmware file associated with ACA.
